verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Databricks has its own job and orchestration primitives: a versioned Jobs REST API, workloads submitted through "jobs," ETL pipelines described as "data orchestration," and SQL alerts that evaluate conditions and notify automatically. None of it explicitly documents recurring schedules (cron, triggers or intervals), so recurring scheduling is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/recurring triggers for jobs or workflows, multi-task workflow scheduling details, hands-on or independent corroboration of scheduled runs.
